reading_decisions.why: Its codes match the corpus — only E04/E08/E12 carry correction lines, failures in E02/E06/E10 genuinely lack corrections, and unknown statuses are preserved not upgraded — and its tentative flags on single-episode generalizations are appropriately cautious.

output.what_changed_my_view: The one reading did not overturn the basic picture; it sharpened the separation between correction (explicit redirection), failure (broken attempt without recorded follow-up), and unknown status (missing evidence), with E04 as the useful counter-example showing failure can precede correction.
